metadata.description: Generates soundtracks from an uploaded image or video, with optional style and mood guidance, audio-range selection, and multiple variations.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

audio_end.description: End time of the soundtrack audio in milliseconds. If both audio_start and audio_end are specified, generation uses those times. If audio_end exceeds the song duration, generation stops at the end of the song. The soundtrack audio segment must be at least 3 seconds long, and a 1-second fade-out is added at the end.
audio_end.title: Audio End

audio_start.description: Start time of the soundtrack audio in milliseconds. If only audio_start is specified, generation starts there and continues for the video duration, stopping at the end of the song if the remaining audio is shorter. The soundtrack audio segment must be at least 3 seconds long, and a 1-second fade-in is added at the beginning.
audio_start.title: Audio Start

enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

image_id.description: Image ID returned by /files/upload with purpose='soundtrack'. Provide exactly one of image_id or video_id.
image_id.title: Image Id

prompt.description: Optional description of the desired soundtrack style and mood.
prompt.title: Prompt

video_id.description: Video ID returned by /files/upload with purpose='soundtrack'. Provide exactly one of image_id or video_id.
video_id.title: Video Id

MurekaV95GenerateSoundtrackOutput.description: A generated audio file and its reusable song identifier.

duration.description: Duration of the generated audio in milliseconds, when available.
duration.title: Duration

lyrics_sections.description: Timed lyric sections for the generated audio, when available.
lyrics_sections.title: Lyrics Sections

song_id.description: Reusable identifier for this audio. Pass it to endpoints that accept song_id.
song_id.title: Song Id

MurekaV95GenerateSoundtrackOutput.title: GeneratedAudioOutput

info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/mureka/v9.5/generate/soundtrack queue.
info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/mureka/v9.5/generate/soundtrack

x-fal-metadata.about:
Create an original soundtrack for an uploaded image or video.

The result contains a completed soundtrack with a reusable ID and audio URL.

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).
